items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: So I got with Billy Pearson, which is Miss Broadway's show. And I played around with him.

ctx.x: They have dancers and all there? Oh, yeah. He had a whole front line of chorus girls.

Yeah. He had 10 chorus girls. Yeah. And four comedians. Comedians, yeah. Yeah. Had a big show. Well, I traveled around with him. I expected ... Well, I went all through Michigan. I would say from here all through the states on into Michigan. Yeah. I went through Seattle, Washington with him. I worked around back in my younger days. Then what happened? I worked back to Dallas, Texas with him. I quit him to get with a show out of Chicago called Billy Pearson Show. The man's name was Billy Pearson. The man of the…
